purpose: Keep photography structurally integrated, editorially legible, and human-gated as the portfolio layout evolves.

evals.title: Photographic sequence carries the argument
evals.criterion: The opening, project, civic-process, archive, and river images form distinct editorial sequences rather than a decorative gallery.

evals.title: Editorial architecture remains coherent
evals.criterion: Image, type, rule, interval, and evidence create a repeatable hierarchy on desktop and mobile.

evals.title: Type and color stay warm, direct, and legible
evals.criterion: The Human Index palette supports meaning without overwhelming photographs or long-form reading.

evals.title: Emergence remains visible
evals.criterion: The design leaves room for discovery and does not reduce artistic, civic, or relational practice to organizational utility.

evals.title: Collective life retains dignity and voice
evals.criterion: Project photographs preserve collective credit and do not make Jamie the sole narrator of shared work.

evals.title: Scenes make the worker visible
evals.criterion: The portfolio shows Jamie in concrete scenes of coordination, fabrication, listening, hospitality, and transition.

evals.title: Photography conveys embodied time
evals.criterion: Sequences convey performance, duration, atmosphere, and the relation between project container and lived event.

evals.title: The public edit is restrained
evals.criterion: Every image and caption earns its place; the homepage introduces while deeper pages carry detail.
